title: Timeline Series
description: A curated, ordered group of timeline records that belong together and should be highlighted together on the chart: a prophecy and its fulfillments, the world powers of Daniel, a succession of kings, the covenants, etc. Members reference event ids from data/raw, data/derived or data/merged. See docs/DATA_SCHEMA.md §10.

title_ta.description: Only text copied from a Tamil jw.org page

description_en.description: 2-4 sentences explaining what the series shows, faithful to the sources

highlight.description: true = give this series its own colour on the chart by default

auto.description: true = generated by scripts/build_series.py from existing data; do not hand-edit

parent_series.description: Series this one belongs under, e.g. 'kings-of-judah' under 'prophets-and-kings-a6'

groups.description: Optional sub-groups inside the series, e.g. each world power with its prophetic symbols, each covenant with its parties.

span_id.description: The span record that represents this group on the timeline, e.g. the 'Babylon, third world power' span

attributes.description: Free key/value facts printed by the source for this group, e.g. {"parties": "Jehovah and Abraham", "purpose": "..."}

event_id.description: id of a record (point or span) in the timeline

order.description: Position in the series (1, 2, 3…). Not necessarily chronological, e.g. prophecy then fulfillment.

label_en.description: Short caption for this member inside the series, as the source words it (e.g. 'Jehovah promises to raise up an offspring')

pairs_with.description: For prophecy members: the event ids of their fulfillments (and vice versa)

scriptures.description: Scripture refs specific to this step, e.g. ['Gen. 3:15']

source_docid.description: docid of the series source that puts this member in the series
